address: María Luisa 24, Zahara de los Atunes, 11393, Spain
bio: A gastro-bar with a pleasant and informal feel enhanced by the decor of unusual recycled objects and furniture! The well-prepared cuisine here is contemporary in style, fresh and light and served in full and half portions. We recommend the mini-Vietnamese-style shrimp omelettes and the spicy “caldereta” stew with white prawns and egg....
